senses.gloss: persuasion, enticing. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 19; Ex. R. s. 3 בפ׳ באתי אליך וכ׳ I came to thee with persuasiveness (making thee believe that thou didst hear thy father’s voice), that thou be not afraid, Ib. בתחלה פ׳ פיתיתי אותך וכ׳ at first I spoke persuasively to thee, now I will speak to thee words of truth (earnest admonition).
units: Ib. אין פתי אלא לשון פ׳ pethi (Prov. XIV, 15) has the meaning of ‘persuasion’ (one easily persuaded); a. fr.—Esp. enticing a virgin, claims of the seduced (Ex. XXII, 15).
<cite ref="Ketubot 35b:7">Keth. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לה לא קנס ולא פ׳</he> she has no claim either of fine (for outrage) or of indemnity for seduction.

senses.gloss: dialect. for פִּיתּוּחַ (cmp. פּוֹתִי a. פּוֹתֵחַ) engraving, moulding.—Pl. פִּיתּוּיִין, פִּתּ׳.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 14:10">Tosef. Ohol. XIV, 10</cite> (R. S. to Ohol. XIV, 1 <he>פִּיתּוּחִין</he>), v. <cite ref="Q00890"><he>פִּיתּוּחַ</he></cite>.
